ex.en: In the end he achieved his objective.
ex.zh: 他終於完成了他的目標。

ex.en: He explained the plan's main objective.
ex.zh: 他解釋了這個計劃的主要目標。

ex.en: The objectives of the marketing department and the sales department are not necessarily the same.
ex.zh: 行銷部和業務部的目標不見得相同。

ex.en: It's hard to stay objective and calm when it happens to you.
ex.zh: 事情發生在自己身上時，很難保持客觀冷靜。

ex.en: I have no objection to your plan.
She has a strong objection to my plan.
If Tom wants to stay, I have no objection.
ex.zh: 如果湯姆想留下來，我沒有意見。
